newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat drops further late on USDA data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat drops further late on USDA data.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures fell further in late dealings on bearish input from Monday's USDA supply/demand and crop production reports, traders said.
USDA pegged 1996/97 U.S. wheat ending stocks at 465 million bushels, above some analysts' expectations for 450 million.
Traders said Rosenthal Collins and locals were the key sellers of wheat futures in late trading.
At 1240 CDT, wheat was four to 12-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with July down 12-1/4 at $4.01-1/2.
